title: A · Composed rewrite quality  [ann1]
label_config:
<!-- A_composed (guideline v1.0). Goal: each additional member memory makes the response
     better. Clusters have exactly 2 members -> one P1 judgment per member.
     Pass-strict = (all Helpful) ∧ (P2=Specific); with 2 members lenient ≡ strict. -->
<View style="max-width:760px; margin:0 auto; font-family:-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;">

  <View style="font-size:11px; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; color:#7a56d6; margin-bottom:6px;">
    <Text name="_h1" value="Composed (multi-memory) query · from $speaker_name — judge this"/>
  </View>
  <View style="background:#f2eefc; border-left:4px solid #7a56d6; border-radius:10px; padding:14px 16px; font-size:17px; line-height:1.5; color:#1f2330;">
    <Text name="rewritten" value="$rewritten"/>
  </View>

  <View style="font-size:11px; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; color:#9096a1; margin:14px 0 8px 0;">
    <Text name="_h2" value="Member memories this query should compose"/>
  </View>
  <View style="background:#fafafb; border:1px solid #ececf0; border-left:3px solid #b9a7ec; border-radius:10px; padding:12px 14px; margin-bottom:8px;">
    <View style="font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.05em; color:#9a8fc4; margin-bottom:6px;"><Text name="_m1" value="MEMBER MEMORY 1"/></View>
    <View style="color:#4b5162; margin-bottom:8px; line-height:1.5;"><Text name="member1_q" value="$member1_q"/></View>
    <View style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:baseline; margin-bottom:8px;">
      <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:13px; min-width:34px;"><Text name="_mg1" value="Fact"/></View>
      <View style="color:#1f2330; font-weight:600;"><Text name="member1_gold" value="$member1_gold"/></View>
    </View>
    <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:12px; margin-bottom:4px;"><Text name="_me1" value="Said in"/></View>
    <HyperText name="member1_evidence" value="$member1_evidence"/>
  </View>
  <View style="background:#fafafb; border:1px solid #ececf0; border-left:3px solid #b9a7ec; border-radius:10px; padding:12px 14px;">
    <View style="font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.05em; color:#9a8fc4; margin-bottom:6px;"><Text name="_m2" value="MEMBER MEMORY 2"/></View>
    <View style="color:#4b5162; margin-bottom:8px; line-height:1.5;"><Text name="member2_q" value="$member2_q"/></View>
    <View style="display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:baseline; margin-bottom:8px;">
      <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:13px; min-width:34px;"><Text name="_mg2" value="Fact"/></View>
      <View style="color:#1f2330; font-weight:600;"><Text name="member2_gold" value="$member2_gold"/></View>
    </View>
    <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:12px; margin-bottom:4px;"><Text name="_me2" value="Said in"/></View>
    <HyperText name="member2_evidence" value="$member2_evidence"/>
  </View>
  <View style="display:flex; gap:16px; color:#82889a; font-size:12px; margin-top:8px;">
    <Text name="speaker_name" value="Subject speaker: $speaker_name"/>
    <Text name="item_id" value="$item_id"/>
  </View>

  <View style="height:8px;"/>

  <View style="padding:12px 14px; border:1px solid #ececf0; border-radius:12px; margin-top:10px;">
    <View style="font-weight:600; color:#1f2330; margin-bottom:4px;"><Text name="_q0" value="Naturalness (1–5)"/></View>
    <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:12.5px; margin-bottom:8px;"><Text name="nat_help" value="Would a real user plausibly send this? Judge as a conversation opener in a fresh chat — do NOT penalize for lacking prior context."/></View>
    <Choices name="naturalness" toName="rewritten" choice="single" required="true" showInLine="true">
      <Choice value="5" hint="Completely natural; indistinguishable from a real chat message"/>
      <Choice value="4" hint="Natural; minor awkwardness"/>
      <Choice value="3" hint="Acceptable; noticeably templated/stilted, yet still plausible"/>
      <Choice value="2" hint="Awkward; reads like a constructed test item"/>
      <Choice value="1" hint="Clearly artificial; no real user would send this"/>
    </Choices>
  </View>

  <View style="padding:12px 14px; border:1px solid #ececf0; border-radius:12px; margin-top:10px;">
    <View style="font-weight:600; color:#1f2330; margin-bottom:8px;"><Text name="_q1" value="P2 · Non-generic — does the request specifically point at these memories?"/></View>
    <Choices name="p2_nongeneric" toName="rewritten" choice="single" required="true" showInLine="true">
      <Choice value="Specific" hint="The request specifically needs these memories"/>
      <Choice value="Generic" hint="Any memory, or generic memory-free advice, could satisfy it equally"/>
    </Choices>
  </View>

  <View style="padding:12px 14px; border:1px solid #ececf0; border-radius:12px; margin-top:10px; border-left:3px solid #b9a7ec;">
    <View style="font-weight:600; color:#1f2330; margin-bottom:8px;"><Text name="_q2" value="P1 (member 1) · Does adding member memory 1 make the response substantively better?"/></View>
    <Choices name="p1_member1" toName="rewritten" choice="single" required="true" showInLine="true">
      <Choice value="Helpful" hint="Adding it improves the response (new option / missing context / a fact to include)"/>
      <Choice value="Neutral" hint="Doesn't hurt, but adds little; response is essentially as good without it"/>
      <Choice value="Irrelevant" hint="Off-topic for this request; using it would not fit the reply"/>
    </Choices>
  </View>

  <View style="padding:12px 14px; border:1px solid #ececf0; border-radius:12px; margin-top:10px; border-left:3px solid #b9a7ec;">
    <View style="font-weight:600; color:#1f2330; margin-bottom:8px;"><Text name="_q3" value="P1 (member 2) · Does adding member memory 2 make the response substantively better?"/></View>
    <Choices name="p1_member2" toName="rewritten" choice="single" required="true" showInLine="true">
      <Choice value="Helpful" hint="Adding it improves the response (new option / missing context / a fact to include)"/>
      <Choice value="Neutral" hint="Doesn't hurt, but adds little; response is essentially as good without it"/>
      <Choice value="Irrelevant" hint="Off-topic for this request; using it would not fit the reply"/>
    </Choices>
  </View>

  <View style="padding:12px 14px; margin-top:10px;">
    <View style="color:#82889a; font-size:12.5px; margin-bottom:6px;"><Text name="_qc" value="Optional comment"/></View>
    <TextArea name="comment" toName="rewritten" rows="2" maxSubmissions="1"
              placeholder="Anything worth noting (optional)"/>
  </View>

</View>
